content: Model. To account for chunk sequences we make use of a de facto standard approach and opt for a recurrent neural model using long short-term memory (LSTM) BIBREF18. In our model, the sequence consists of a sequence of tweets belonging to one chunk (Figure FIGREF11). The LSTM learns the hidden state $h\textsubscript {t}$ by capturing the previous timesteps (past tweets). The produced hidden state $h\textsubscript {t}$ at each time step is passed to the attention layer which computes a `context' vector $c\textsubscript {t}$ as the weighted mean of the state sequence $h$ by:
